turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Any music that actually helps a baby sleep? She's three months and fighting it every night.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Soft, slow and repetitive works best. Lullabies, gentle piano or even white noise can help.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, a fan or a white noise app. It reminds babies of the sounds in the womb, which is calming.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've been singing to her but

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I only know about two songs.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's fine, babies love repetition. Your voice is the most soothing sound to her, even if you sing the same song every night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ha, she's going to be sick of that song.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: She'll probably love it. Keep the volume low and the lights dim, and keep the routine the same each night.
